# Test fixtures

Small text-based CAD samples (everything else is generated by the tests).

- `cube-10mm.stp`, `cube-10mm.igs` — a 10 × 10 × 10 mm cube, taken from the test files of
  [occt-import-js](https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js) (LGPL-2.1), with the original
  author's name and file path removed from the headers.
- `sample-rar4.rar`, `sample-rar5.rar` — tiny RAR archives from the
  [libarchive](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive) test suite (BSD-2-Clause), decoded from
  `test_read_format_rar.rar.uu` and `test_read_format_rar5_compressed.rar.uu` (v3.7.2).
  RAR can't be created with free tools, so these are the only way to test reading it.
- `sample.7z` (two text files) and `sample-aes.zip` (one file, WinZip AES-256, password
  `s3cret`) — made with py7zr / pyzipper, for the browser tests (the CI runner's Python can't
  write these formats).
